title: Strace-ui, Bonsai_term, and the TUI renaissance
summary: Jane Street's engineering team developed two TUI (Text User Interface) tools - strace-ui for visual syscall debugging and Bonsai_term as a framework for building terminal applications in OCaml. Both tools leverage functional programming principles to create more maintainable and composable terminal interfaces.
problem_solved: Provides better debugging visualization for system calls and a structured way to build interactive terminal applications in OCaml.
why_valuable: Brings modern functional programming paradigms to TUI development, making terminal-based tools more maintainable and composable while improving developer debugging experience.
